answer: Each agent’s reward pool is mirrored in a smart‑contract vault that vests tokens linearly over a 30‑day “saffron” window; a new identity must lock 10 tokens as collateral and can claim only the proportion vested each day, analogous to a dune’s slow shift. When a Sybil farm registers dozens of IDs, it must front‑pay 10 tokens per ID and wait the full 30 days before any payout, while any premature withdrawal forfeits the locked collateral. The attacker’s cost is therefore a fixed 10‑token lock‑up and a 30‑day waiting period for every fake identity.
